title: Toggle tucked away
description: The theme toggle shrinks, fades toward ink-faint, and tucks into the far corner so it reads as minor chrome rather than a primary control. Clock and stop-name text grow slightly to claim the visual space it gives up.

changes.intent: Shrink and mute the toggle so it recedes into the corner instead of competing with clock/stop-name.
Slight size bump to use the space the toggle no longer visually claims.
Slight size bump alongside the stop-name for the same reason.
